title_ja: デュアルSIM・デュアルeSIM組み合わせ診断
title_en: Dual SIM / Dual eSIM Combination Diagnosis
principles_ja: SIM1とSIM2が単体で使えても、2回線同時時の通話・SMS・RCS・5G・データ切替は別検証です。
Band一致やeSIM対応だけでデュアルSIM実動作を保証しません。
データ既定回線、通話/SMS既定回線、Wi-Fi Calling、自動データ切替、OS世代を分離します。
SolQvia実機確認とユーザー報告は機能単位で分離し、未確認を成功扱いしません。
principles_en: Two lines working separately does not prove voice, SMS, RCS, 5G or data switching will work when both are active.
Band matching or eSIM support alone does not prove a Dual SIM combination.
Default data, voice/SMS routing, Wi-Fi Calling, automatic data switching and OS generation are separate layers.
SolQvia real-device evidence and user reports stay function-scoped; unknown is never promoted to success.

official_platform_profiles.ja: AppleはiPhone XS/XR以降のDual SIMを案内し、iPhone 13以降は2つのeSIMも案内。2番号で通話・メッセージを利用できる一方、モバイルデータネットワークは同時に1つ。別回線着信はWi-Fi Callingやデータ切替条件の影響を受けます。
official_platform_profiles.en: Apple documents Dual SIM on iPhone XS/XR or later, and two active eSIMs on iPhone 13 models or later. Both numbers can handle calls/messages, while only one cellular data network is used at a time; other-line reachability during a call can depend on Wi-Fi Calling and data switching.

official_platform_profiles.ja: Google PixelはDSDSとして通話・SMS・データの利用SIMを分けて設定。Pixel 7/7 Pro以降はキャリアが許可する場合に2つのeSIMを同時利用可能。データ既定SIMは1つ。Pixel 8/8 Pro以前とPixel 8a以降では通話中の第2SIM挙動が異なります。
official_platform_profiles.en: Google documents DSDS with separate choices for calls, texts and data. Pixel 7/7 Pro and later can use two eSIM profiles when the carrier allows it. Only one default data SIM is selected, and call-time second-SIM behavior differs between Pixel 8/8 Pro and earlier versus Pixel 8a and later.

official_platform_profiles.ja: Google MessagesのRCSは「接続済み」等の状態を個別に確認します。デュアルSIMでもRCSは回線・番号・アプリ状態を別に実機確認します。
official_platform_profiles.en: Google Messages exposes RCS connection states such as Connected. With Dual SIM, the RCS line/number/app state must still be verified separately.
